queries.message: What are the benefits of PM Kisan Samman Nidhi?
queries.reply:
The PM Kisan Samman Nidhi scheme provides financial support to farmers.

Under this scheme, eligible farmers receive ₹6,000 per year. This amount is paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 each. The funds are directly transferred into the farmer's bank account to help with their agricultural credit needs.
